title: Workshop closing time
side_a: Our shared workshop closes at nine. I want the final fifteen minutes reserved for cleaning so nobody inherits a messy bench. Members would stop projects a little earlier, but the space would be ready for the next morning.
side_b: Our shared workshop closes at nine. I want members to finish projects until closing and clean their own stations afterward. Many people arrive late after work, and losing fifteen usable minutes matters to them.
